newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil drifts aimlessly to close mixed.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil drifts aimlessly to close mixed.

text.p: Palm oil prices reversed earlier firm trend and closed slightly lower, after drifiting aimlessly with players unsure of the short-term direction following recent strong volatility, traders said. "Uncertain condition was seen in the afternoon session with players unsure of the trend," a trader said.

"The market is seen consolidating at around current levels after recent sharp falls," he said, adding that prices are likely to fluctuate in a tight range in near-term until fresh developments appear.

Third month April futures drifted in a tight range in the afternoon session before closing one ringgit lower at 1,260 ringgit ($507.96) a tonne. Traders said the next support level will be 1,255 and resistance at 1,280 for next week.
Physical Jan (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,335 against bids at 1,327.50 after trading at 1,345 and 1,330.
Jan (central) was offered at 1,325 and bids at 1,317.50, and Jan (north) at 1,305 against 1,295.
Feb (south) saw offers at 1,335 with bids at 1,330 and Feb (central) at 1,325 against 1,312.50.
Among refined products, Feb RBD palm oil was offered at $560 a tonne FOB Malaysia and Mar at $555. Feb was traded at $557.50.
Jan RBD palm olein saw offers at $592.50, Mar at $580 and Apr/May/Jun at $572.50. Apr/May/Jun was traded at $570.
Jan/Feb/Mar RBD palm stearin was offered at $435 and Feb/Mar palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $300.
